executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Run API integration tests against the live SmartDine Cloud Gateway at https://smartdine-saas.ew.r.appspot.com. Test the following 4 endpoints: 1) POST /auth/register to onboard a new test restaurant named TestSprite Bistro with tables, areas, and menu items; 2) POST /auth/login with 3 paths: by restaurant name, by phone (9988776655), and negative test with wrong password; 3) GET /api/public/provision/activate?code=SYNC_CODE from step 1 to verify config DTO is returned; 4) POST /api/sync/process?type=ORDER with JWT from step 2 and a mock outbox event. All requests go to https://smartdine-saas.ew.r.appspot.com. DO NOT test localhost. Use isTest: true in registration payload.
